content.text: By the end of this lesson, you should be able to:
Describe the structure of sensory, relay, and motor neurones
Explain how neurone structure is related to function
Describe the structure and function of the myelin sheath
Explain the role of synapses in transmitting impulses

are specialised cells that transmit electrical impulses. Their structure is highly adapted for rapid communication across long distances in the body. Understanding neurone structure helps explain how the nervous system functions.
